column1: # Custom 4 MiB ESP32 layout based on the framework's min_spiffs.csv.
# Preserves the stock OTA app sizes and 128 KiB SPIFFS partition.
# The 64 KiB stock coredump partition is shortened to 60 KiB so ProductInfo
# can occupy the final 4 KiB of flash at the fixed address 0x3FF000.
# Active layout:
#   NVS         stores non-volatile settings.
#   OTA data    selects which application slot to boot.
#   app0/app1   provide two equal OTA firmware slots.
#   SPIFFS      preserves the stock min_spiffs.csv size of 128 KiB.
#   coredump    retains 60 KiB for ESP-IDF crash dumps (enable in sdkconfig).
#   productinfo fixed-address
# Flash address ranges are end-exclusive; the final partition ends at 0x400000.
# Note: declaring coredump here reserves flash but does not enable core dumps;
#       ESP-IDF coredump-to-flash support must also be enabled in the build config.
# Name
nvs
otadata
app0
app1
spiffs
coredump
productinfo
